events.title: 로날트 쿠만 starts as manager at Dutch club 피테서 .

리버풀 suffer a shock 1–0 home defeat to 블랙번 로버스 in the FA Cup fourth round. 트랜미어 로버스, on a good run in the League Cup, progress to the fifth round of the FA Cup after a surprise 1–0 win at home to 선덜랜드 in the fourth round. There is a major shock also for 브래드퍼드 시티, who are crushed 3–1 by Division Two 질링엄 at Priestfield .
Liberian striker 조지 웨아 , 31, joins 첼시 on a six-month loan from A.C. AC 밀란 .
아스널's hopes of FA Cup glory are ended in a replay penalty shoot-out defeat by 레스터 시티, who boost their own bid for a cup double.

The FA Cup fifth round brings some surprise results as 질링엄's giant-killing run continues with a 3–1 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 win at 코번트리 시티 to give the rest of the Premier League some idea of what they will be performing like when inevitable promotion is achieved. 레스터 시티's hopes of a domestic cup double are ended when they lose 2–1 at 첼시, while 케임브리지 유나이티드's impressive run ends in a 3–1 home defeat by 볼턴 원더러스. On the transfer front, Division One strugglers 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 sell their Italian midfielder 엔초 마레스카 to 유벤투스 for £4 million.
블랙풀 striker Martin Aldridge , 25, on loan to Rushden & Diamonds , dies in an Oxford hospital after being injured in a car crash in Northamptonshire .

Struggling 셰필드 웬즈데이 complete the month unbeaten in the FA Premier League . 대니 윌슨 is named FA Premier League Manager of the Month , but the club are still in the relegation zone, though no longer in the bottom place (now occupied by 왓퍼드. 브래드퍼드 시티 occupy the other relegation position. 맨체스터 유나이티드 now lead at the top on goal difference ahead of 리즈 유나이티드, with 아스널 and 리버풀 still posing a threat but 선덜랜드's challenge is ebbing away. 찰턴 애슬레틱 have taken over from 맨체스터 시티 as Division One leaders. 입스위치 타운, 반즐리, 허더즈필드 타운 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 complete the top six.
